title: carex nitida var. supina
intro: Carex nitida var. supina, commonly known as Upland Sedge, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Cyperaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Upland Sedge are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been identified through phytochemical analysis.
